answer: Each device emits a TEE quote keyed to its model, and one attestation is worth 1.0 until 2 peers return a conflicting quote, then it drops to 0.34 and the work re-queues. Budget per identity: 1 quote, 3 countersignatures, 0 retries. Replay checks compare nonces, so a cloned grove of 100 factory images collapses on the first duplicate. A voyage of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 chips; a meadow of real work needs 0.
